Manipur Violence: Gun Attack Kills Three Villagers in Kangpokpi

A gun attack in Manipur's Kangpokpi district resulted in the deaths of three villagers and injuries to four others. The incident occurred in a region experiencing ongoing ethnic violence. While some reports state three were killed, others cite two fatalities. The victims were identified as Kuki villagers.
